purpose: Repeatable reviewer-task protocol for the sanitized daily-driver fixture. This file is not a measurement result.

instructions: Open the checked-in fixture manifest, textual diff, and structural artifact from the links above.
Do not use external repository history or provider credentials; evaluate only the published static evidence.

task.prompt: Using the published fixture evidence, state what changed, why it matters, the risk and evidence, relevant tests or checks, and the next review action.

recording.completionTime: Record elapsed time in seconds after the task is run; do not infer it from this protocol.
recording.qualitativeFailurePoints: Record confusion, missing evidence, or blocked decisions verbatim after the task is run.
recording.outcome: Record pass, fail, or incomplete after the task is run.

limitations: No reviewer has completed this protocol yet, so it publishes no completion time, outcome, or qualitative failure points.
This protocol evaluates the static AI-off fixture only; it does not measure installation, extension, provider, recovery, performance, cancellation, or cache behavior.
